messages.english: Quick sale names rand and links to invoices in another currency.
messages.translation: U rengisa ha u tavhanya hu bula randa nahone hu vhambedza na ma-invoisi nga inwe tshelede.
Nangani u dzhenisa thengiso ho teaho

messages.english: My Records → Sold → Quick sale entry
messages.translation: Zwirekhodi Zhanga → Zwo rengiswaho → U dzhenisa thengiso ha u tavhanya

messages.english: Quick sale records South African rand (ZAR). For another supported currency, open the separate sale-invoice form and choose its currency and payment status. Enter the sale there; the quick-sale draft is not transferred.
messages.translation: U rengisa ha u tavhanya hu rekhoda randa ya Afurika Tshipembe (ZAR). Kha inwe tshelede i tikedzwaho, vhulani fomo yo fhambanaho ya invoisi ya thengiso nahone ni nange tshelede yayo na tshiimo tsha mbadelo. Dzhenisani thengiso henefho; drafu ya u rengisa ha u tavhanya a i fhiriselwi.

messages.english: See when monthly temperatures are incomplete or need another check.
messages.translation: Vhonani musi vhudalo ha mufhiso wa nwedzi na nwedzi vhu songo fhelelaho kana vhu tshi toda inwe thodisiso.
Tolani u vha hone ha zwidodombedzwa zwa mufhiso wa nwedzi na nwedzi

messages.english: Map → Site details → Overview or Climate
messages.translation: Mmepe → Zwidodombedzwa zwa fhethu → Manweledzo kana Kilaimethe

messages.english: Check whether all monthly mean temperatures were supplied. Missing or unrecorded coverage holds the monthly calendar and planner climate interpretation; reload online to try again. Your saved maps, records and original estimates remain available. Complete model inputs do not confirm local crop suitability.
messages.translation: Tolani arali mufhiso wothe wa vhukati (avhareji) wa nwedzi na nwedzi wo netshedzwa. U vha hone ha zwidodombedzwa ho xelaho kana ho sa rekhodiwaho hu fara khalendara ya nwedzi na nwedzi na thaluso ya kilaimethe ya mulanganyi; vusani kha inthanethe u lingedza hafhu. Mimepe yavho yo vhulungwaho, zwirekhodi na mithelo yo rathwaho zwi dzula zwi hone. Zwidzheniswa zwothe zwa modele a zwi khwathisedzi u teya ha zwimela zwa henefho.

messages.english: Choose app help separately from advice about a saved site.
messages.translation: Nangani thusedzo ya apu thungo ha nyeletshedzo nga ha fhethu ho vhulungwaho.

messages.english: Review your LimaBar question before sending it.
messages.translation: Sedzulusani mbudziso yavho ya LimaBar musi ni sa athu u i rumela.

messages.english: Choose the scope of your question

Choose Using the app for general help without attaching saved-site or record context. Advice about your own site needs supported country details saved to your signed-in account. Replies and attachments retire when their context changes. Manual maps and records remain available.
messages.translation: Nangani U shumisa apu kha thusedzo yo teaho hu si na u nambatedza fhethu ho vhulungwaho kana zwirekhodi. Nyeletshedzo nga ha fhethu havho i toda zwidodombedzwa zwa shango zwi tikedzwaho zwo vhulungwaho kha akhauthi yavho yo dzheniswaho. Phindulo na zwinambatedzwa zwi a fhela musi tshiimo tshazwo tshi tshi shanduka. Mimepe na zwirekhodi zwine na zwi shumisa nga vhune kha apu zwi dzula zwi hone.
